AccountSequenceNumber.name: Account Sequence Number
AccountSequenceNumber.definition: Link to the account for multi-account deposit.

AmountToDeposit.name: Amount To Deposit
AmountToDeposit.definition: Amount of the deposit to be made on the ATM after the approval of the deposit transaction.

Currency.name: Currency
Currency.definition: Currency of the amount to deposit when different from the base currency of the ATM.

Fees.name: Fees
Fees.definition: Deposit fees, accepted by the customer.
